lineageCorrection.finding: The 2013 split is not earliest authorship: several current protocol JSONs pass through WebCore/inspector/protocol/*.json to this WebCore/inspector/Inspector.json ancestor. Its line history reaches 2011 commits, including Chromium-address contributors. The preserved source path is within the WebKit repository; no external repository path was observed in the captured blame chain.

correction: The linked terms receipt called the earliest visible current-file commits 2013 or later; that phrasing overstated the ancestry. The 2013 split is a move boundary. The underlying file has 2011 WebKit history and Chromium-domain contributor identities. Keep the maintainer BSD-2 classification only as WebKit contributions under the official WebKit policy; do not infer individual copyright owners from committer email or claim an independent Chromium grant.

policy.finding: WebKit says new code contributed to WebKit uses BSD-2-Clause and moved code retains its original license/copyright. This supports a WebKit-tree maintainer term classification, while contributor attribution still requires exact notice evidence.

inputSet.terms: BSD-2-Clause maintainer classification retained for these exact 32 hashes, subject to source offer notice integration and reevaluation if a different external origin is established.

limitations: Blame and repository path establish contribution history but not copyright ownership alone.
